content.overview: Resistance management aims to reduce repeated selection pressure on pest populations. Product brand names do not define resistance-management diversity; mode of action, pest biology, treatment history, efficacy and local guidance matter.

vocabulary.definition: The biochemical or physiological process through which a pesticide affects the target organism.
The survival advantage given to resistant individuals when repeated interventions preferentially remove susceptible individuals.
Resistance mechanism(s) that reduce susceptibility to more than one active ingredient or mode-of-action group.

sections.title: Different brand does not necessarily mean different MoA
sections.body: Rotating between brand names that share the same mode of action can maintain similar selection pressure. Resistance stewardship therefore tracks active ingredient and MoA classification, not branding alone.

sections.title: Use chemical tools inside IPM
sections.body: Resistance-management guidance emphasizes monitoring and integrating multiple control strategies rather than relying on a single chemical tactic. Rotation/sequence principles must be adapted to the target pest, crop stage, local resistance information and legal options.

sections.title: Label and legal authority still control use
sections.body: A sound MoA plan does not authorize an otherwise illegal or off-label application. Current product labeling, crop/site registration, worker safety, applicator requirements and jurisdictional rules remain controlling.

workedExamples: Switching from one product to a different brand with the same MoA group is not meaningful rotation merely because the package name changed.
commonMistakes: Rotating by brand instead of mode of action.
Using sub-label rates to 'reduce selection pressure.'
Treating resistance guidance as authorization to use a product on cannabis.
content.practicalApplication: Given a mock treatment history, flag repeated MoA exposure, identify where nonchemical tactics could reduce selection pressure, and state what label/local-authority checks are required before any chemical change.
content.summary: Resistance stewardship tracks biological selection pressure and mode of action while preserving the legal and operational boundaries of pesticide use.
